entries.cc544a023fc74e55: Under its management philosophy of 'Pursuing true value and sharing its joy,' it has set out the Medium-Term Management Plan – Nakamuraya 2027 Vision. Its basic policies are the following 4: practicing philosophy-based management; rebuilding the value chain and infrastructure from planning and development through production, logistics and sales; investing in brands and human resource development; and creating value through 'food that blends into everyday life'. By segment, it aims to turn Chinese steamed buns from a winter seasonal product into a year-round staple in the confectionery business, expand proposals for ready-made meals in the food business, and work to secure stable earnings by utilizing its owned land in the real estate leasing business.
